matchup.plan_title: Plan (10:00 UTC 25 Nov, after the news watch): three adds left
matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- **Score after Tue 24:** **378 to 391**, down 13. Tuesday went 140 to 53.
- **Roster moves recorded (ESPN sync):** none since 24 Nov. Queta is still on the roster.
- **Adds:** 3 used this matchup of 6, so **3 left** (the script's *Adds* line).
- **With no more moves:** our lineup 1,010 over Wed–Sun, theirs 1,011. Final about **1,388 to 1,402**.
- **Pending trades:** none of them holds up any move below (standing rule).

**Research that shapes the plan** (news and injury watch, 25 Nov):
- **Charles Bassey** keeps the Golden State start. Kerr on 24 Nov: "hopefully for the season" ([Yahoo, 24 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/articles/steve-kerr-addresses-warriors-look-221429191.html)). He is not on Wednesday's report. Role row: 24 min (role rate 35.8 ‡, rate 29.5). He plays Wed, Fri and Sun.
- **Neemias Queta** scored 48 FP in 25 min Tuesday, a blowout, with Mitchell Robinson out (no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 27 Nov). His 30-min row expired. Rate 33.3. He plays Fri and Sun only.
- **Cade Cunningham** was a late scratch Tuesday with right knee soreness ([Yahoo, 25 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/articles/cade-cunningham-injury-pistons-pg-000304132.html)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 27 Nov. The projection counts him Fri and Sun.
- **Jalen Duren** practised Tuesday and goes to the G League on Wednesday. His return is "imminent", with no date ([AP via NBA.com, 25 Nov](https://www.nba.com/news/jalen-duren-hamstring-practices-with-pistons-ahead-of-rehab-stint)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 30 Nov. Sunday is possible. If he plays Sunday, our Sunday is full without an add.
- **Jalen Smith** and **Yaxel Lendeborg** are questionable Wednesday with illnesses ([NBA injury report, 25 Nov 4:00 AM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-25_04_00AM.pdf)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 25 Nov for both.
- **Myles Turner:** Sat 28 is the second night of a back-to-back. He has one rest night in three (11 Nov). Nothing is announced.
- **De'Andre Hunter** starts at 35–41 min. Maxime Raynaud is out until 2 Dec at the earliest (row; *ESPN est.* 2 Dec). Sacramento plays Sun 29.
- **Tristan da Silva** starts while Paolo Banchero is out. Banchero misses Sat and Sun (floor row 1 Dec; *ESPN est.* 29 Nov). Orlando plays Sat and Sun.
- **Sunday's other options:**
  - **Quentin Grimes** goes back to the bench when Austin Reaves returns Friday.
  - **Daniss Jenkins'** start ends when Duren returns. His 37-min row runs only through Friday.

**The plans scored** (`council/matchup.py --from D --end D --swap ...` on each day's roster):

| Plan | **Wed 25** · adds by **Thu 9:00 AM** | **Fri 27** · by **Sat 11:00 AM** | **Sat 28** · by **Sun 9:00 AM** | **Sun 29** · by **Mon 7:30 AM** | Adds | Wed–Sun | Final |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| **The plan** | Queta → **Bassey** | — | Lopez → **da Silva** | Turner → **Hunter** | 3 | **1,099** | **about 1,477 to 1,402** |
| Two adds | Queta → Bassey | — | — | Turner → Hunter | 2 | 1,083 | about 1,461 to 1,402 |
| Script's 3-slot search | Queta → Ware | — | — | Ware → Bassey; Turner → Grimes | 3 | 1,090 | about 1,468 to 1,402 |
| No moves | — | — | — | — | 0 | 1,010 | about 1,388 to 1,402 |

By day (our lineup):

| Plan | Wed 25 | Fri 27 | Sat 28 | Sun 29 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| The plan | 204 | 357 | 159 | 379 |
| Two adds | 204 | 357 | 136 | 386 |
| No moves | 168 | 354 | 136 | 352 |

Alternatives scored (same days, same other moves):

| Day | Option | That day | Next day | Note |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Sat 28 | Lopez → **da Silva** | 159 | Sun 379 | plays Sat and Sun |
| Sat 28 | Lopez → Suggs | 157 | Sun 378 | same games, slightly lower rate |
| Sat 28 | Lopez → Hield | 165 | Sun 357 | no Sunday game, and his start ends when Powell returns |
| Sun 29 | Turner → **Hunter** | 379 | — | starter either way |
| Sun 29 | Turner → Grimes | 381 | — | bench once Reaves is back |
| Sun 29 | Turner → Jenkins | 380 | — | start ends when Duren returns |

**Verdict:**
- **Queta → Bassey on Wednesday** is +36 that day: Bassey adds a Wednesday game and covers Queta's Friday and Sunday.
- **Lopez → da Silva on Saturday** is +23 Sat and −7 Sun (da Silva in place of Lopez), net +16 for one add.
- **Turner → Hunter on Sunday** fills the open Sunday slot: +32 (386 against 354 with Bassey alone). Grimes and Jenkins score within 2 of Hunter, but each has a role that ends this week, so Hunter is the safer start.
- **The rotation below** (Bassey in as a what-if) picks da Silva on Saturday and **Grimes** on Sunday, +48.9 over keeping Lopez and Turner. Grimes's rate counts his starts, though, and he returns to the bench when Reaves is back on Friday, so the plan takes Hunter (−2 on the rate).
- The script's own 3-slot search (`--rotate ... --beam 30`) found +79.9; the replayed plan is +89.

**Steps, Melbourne time** (adds close at each US day's first tip-off):
1. **Wednesday:** Queta has no Wednesday game. Drop him any time and add **Charles Bassey** before **9:00 AM Thu 26**. Bassey plays SAC at 2:00 PM Thu.
2. **Saturday:** after the Clippers' Friday game (tip-off 1:30 PM Sat), drop **Brook Lopez** and add **Tristan da Silva** before **9:00 AM Sun 29**, when Orlando plays Saturday's first game.
3. **Sunday:** after Milwaukee vs OKC (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun), drop **Myles Turner** and add **De'Andre Hunter** before **7:30 AM Mon 30**. Check Detroit's Sunday injury report first. If Duren is active, our Sunday is already full, and Hunter only replaces our lowest starter that day.

**Risks:**
- **Bassey's** start is Kerr's choice: Al Horford is healthy.
- **Cunningham's knee:** if he sits Friday, Friday gets an open slot, and the full plan leaves no add to fill it. Detroit's Friday report comes out Thursday.
- **Turner** may rest Saturday. That costs about 34, and no add can cover it.
- **da Silva** has been cold: L7 19.8 (4), rate 22.4.

**Why the L7s are 5+ off the season:**
- **Bassey, +15.7:** starting, 24.3 min against 15.6.
- **Hunter, +10.9:** 37.8 min against 33.9, and a 30-point game on 20 Nov.
- **Grimes, +15.9:** starting with Reaves out (35.5 min against 29.1).
- **Hield, +14.2:** starting for Powell (27.2 min against 18.5).
- **Queta, +9.3:** 28 min with Robinson out, and Tuesday's 48-FP game.

- **Our other players:**
  - **Cunningham, −9.8:** same minutes; he has been playing through right knee soreness.
  - **Anthony Black, −9.8:** shooting, plus Tuesday's 3-FP game (5 turnovers); his minutes held.
